name: alert
behavior: APG alert pattern (in-flow, persistent message; role=alert for warning/critical, role=status for info/success; announced without moving focus; never auto-dismissed; any dismiss control is keyboard reachable)

parts.note: tone axis adds the status accent: status-<tone>-surface fill + status-<tone>-border. Salt Banner paints a full tonal background, shadcn keeps the card surface and tones only the icon/title — a RECIPE difference on root.
tone axis swaps the role and colour: info → info, success → success, warning → warning, critical → error (status-<tone>)
hosts ghost/link prominence buttons (anatomy/button.json) — Salt BannerActions; adds no recipe of its own

anatomyNotes: Alert is toast's in-flow sibling: identical parts, no layer-notification, no auto-dismiss, no enter/exit motion. Salt Banner's variant primary|secondary (background emphasis) is a RECIPE difference on root, not an axis — status components take tone, never emphasis. Salt renders the icon through StatusIndicator; shadcn expects a caller-supplied svg — same part either way.
